name: Machinemodule
description: The Elektron Machinedrum SPS-1 UW's sound engine, emulated: 16 tracks on the 16 pads, the editor follows the pad you hit. Test build.
author: sd88me

assets.label: Machinedrum OS
assets.description: Requires the Machinedrum SPS-1 UW OS 1.63 file (.syx), a free download from Elektron's Machinedrum support page.
assets.hint: Download the Machinedrum UW OS 1.63 from elektron.se, unzip it and upload the .syx file.

assets.label: Machinedrum flash image
assets.description: Optional: the Machinedrum UW 1.63 flash image (.bin, 8 MB). Machinemodule boots it once in the emulated Machinedrum (about 6 minutes, the first time the module starts after the upload) and keeps the 16 factory kits and the ROM machines' samples. Nothing from it is shipped.

assets.label: Your kits
assets.description: Optional: Machinedrum kit dumps (.syx, one or many kits per file, as the MD sends them). They are listed on the Kit page after the factory kits.
